items.title: Balneário Piçarras (SC) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 18 #PRI 2
items.en_title: Balneário Piçarras (SC) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 18 #PRI 2
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Balneário Piçarras (SC) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 348,000; proposals close Nov 18, 08:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
